assertions.name: t1_tensor_t1_eq_A_plus_T1_plus_H
assertions.source: Exact character inner products on the 5 conjugacy classes of A5 give multiplicity 1 for each of A, T1, H and 0 for T2, G — so T1 (x) T1 = A + T1 + H with dims 1+3+5 = 9. Character table orthonormality is asserted first, so the decomposition is not read off an unvalidated table.

assertions.name: sym_alt_split_is_6_plus_3
assertions.source: Sym^2 T1 = A + H (dim 6) and Alt^2 T1 = T1 (dim 3), computed from the class-squaring map (note the 5-cycle classes swap under squaring — the index-2 fusion behind the T1/T2 chirality). This is the canonical Z/2 grading of the 9 color pairs.

assertions.name: uniform_projection_is_isotypy_blind_barycentre
assertions.source: The three isotypic projectors sum to the identity on the 9-dimensional color-pair space, whose diagonal is 1 on every pair; normalising by 9 returns exactly W = 1/9. So the uniform-flavor projection is the isotypy-blind average of the canonical weight systems — a structural reading of the projection the conjecture identifies as lossy.

description: Decomposes the color-pair space T1 (x) T1 of the icosahedral fiber action (bean qou-ctkw; open question 1 of conj:inter-nucleon-channel-color-tube). The three color sheets ARE the T1 irrep (Lean color_sheets_carry_T1) and BringFiberAction is discharged, so ordered color-sheet pairs carry T1 (x) T1. Exact character arithmetic over Q(sqrt 5) on the 5 classes of A5 gives T1 (x) T1 = A + T1 + H (1+3+5=9), with Sym^2 = A + H (6) and Alt^2 = T1 (3) — a canonical Z/2 grading of the 9 color pairs, the shape the block's representation-theoretic eps constraint requires. Each isotypic projector induces a normalised weight system, and the uniform-flavor projection W=1/9 is exactly their identity-sum barycentre: the projection the conjecture calls lossy IS the isotypy-blind average. NARROWS W from 8 free parameters per flavor pair to a 2-parameter convex combination of three canonical systems. Does NOT close open question 1 — the flavor dependence (F1,F2) is not supplied by the color side. Scope-(a); 0 TUNED parameters (nothing fitted, no target consulted) — distinct from the RESULT, which is that W still lives in a 2-parameter convex family: the probe introduces no parameters, it REDUCES the ones W already had, from 8 to 2. Nothing wired.
